items.actClause: AN ACT to amend the highway law, in relation to designating a portion of the state highway system as the "6994th security squadron highway"
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:S5582

TITLE OF BILL:

An act to amend the highway law, in relation to designating a portion of
the state highway system as the "6994th security squadron highway"

PURPOSE:

To designate a portion of the interstate highway system as the "6994th
Security Squadron" highway.

SUMMARY:

Section 1 amends the highway law by adding a new section, 344b in order
that a portion of interstate highway 86 be designated as the "6994th
Security Squadron."

Section 2 directs the commissioner of the department of transportation
to provide for "6994th Security Squadron" signage.

Section 3 provides the enacting clause.

JUSTIFICATION:

This legislation would celebrate the 6994th Security Squadron and would
pay tribute to the service to our State and Country the squadron has
provided.

LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

New bill

FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

None. Current project costs will cover the signage.

EFFECTIVE DATE:

This act shall take effect immediately.

A.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S5582a

 TITLE OF BILL :  An act to amend the highway law, in relation to
designating a portion of the state highway system as the "6994th
SECURITY SQUADRON MEMORIAL HIGHWAY"

 PURPOSE :

To designate a portion of the interstate highway system as the "6994th
SECURITY SQUADRON MEMORIAL HIGHWAY".

 SUMMARY :

Section 1 amends the highway law by adding a new section, 344e in
order that a portion of interstate highway 86 be designated as the
"6994th SECURITY SQUADRON MEMORIAL HIGHWAY"

Section 2 directs the commissioner of the department of transportation
to provide for "6994th SECURITY SQUADRON MEMORIAL HIGHWAY" signage.
However, to avoid confusion and limit any possible disruption of
commerce, the designation shall be one of ceremonial nature and the
official name of such highway shall not be changed as a result of this
act.

Section 3 provides the enacting clause.

 JUSTIFICATION :

This legislation would celebrate the 6994th Security Squadron and
would pay tribute to the service to our State and Country the squadron
has provided.

 LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :

New bill

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :

None. Current project costs will cover the signage.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
This act shall take effect immediately.
